services.name: Boat tour
services.desc: San Francisco City Tour + Bay Cruise is a guided small-group experience that blends landmark exploration on land with a 60-minute narrated cruise on the San Francisco Bay. The tour is shared, built for comfort, and includes hotel pickup and drop-off in San Francisco. From city landmarks to Wine Country and redwood forests, we create unforgettable tours. Fill out the form and our team will help you plan your perfect adventure. San Francisco City Tour + Bay Cruise is a half-day guided journey that captures the city’s most famous sights, neighborhoods, history, and viewpoints, followed by a scenic 60-minute narrated round-trip cruise on the Bay. The land portion includes multiple photo stops
